lines.en: I advance with my blade up.
My boots crunch over gravel.
I walk, scanning left and right.
I approach from a new angle.
I step back to open the distance.
I move along the chamber's wall.

lines.zh: 我的剑尖一直朝着前方
lines.en: My blade tip stays forward.
I go around the side of the coffin.
I walk steadily, unhurried.
I switch my sword to the other hand.
I lower my blade tip and walk on.
I turn to guard my flank.
I stand with my sword on my shoulder.
Only the torches speak in this tomb.
I am waiting for an order.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼吸，其实不需要
lines.en: I breathe slowly, though I need not.
There is frost on my plates.
I look at the blade in my hand.
I know this cold well.
I do not move a finger bone.
I hear kin on the other side.
I straighten my helmet.
I doubt you have even drawn your blade.
My blade is not yet drawn.
You are looking at my armour.

lines.zh: 这里埋着的东西不该被翻出来
lines.en: What is buried here should stay buried.
I neither fear nor hate you.
How many did you bring?
I know your gear.
You are standing on tomb ground.
I raise my hand for you to halt.
Ice runs in me, not blood.

lines.zh: 你手里那块盾挡不住寒气
lines.en: That shield will not stop the cold.
I angle my blade.
A gap opens in my plate.
I shift half a pace back.

lines.zh: 你的刀口正好卡在我甲缝。
lines.en: Your edge caught right in the seam of my plate.
Something clacks in my ribs.
Frost seeps from the wound.
I settle my grip on the blade.
I will count that against you.
Both my legs are still up.
I adjust my stance.
There is skill in that strike.
The dead have no need of food.
What is that for?
I do not eat, and cannot.
Take it back to your side.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿喂不饱一具尸鬼。
lines.en: That will not feed a draugr.
I am guarding a tomb; no time.
I glance at it, then look away.
I want none of it.
This does not interest me.
Take what you hold further off.
You hit my armour.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的甲又响了一声。
lines.en: One bump, and my plate rings again.
That was real strength.
Do not press against me.
I nearly lost my blade.
We collide and every plate rings.
I shove you off to make space.
I have marked that on my plate.
Your foot is on mine.
I drop my weight and hold.
I have been dead many years.
Such things were buried with me.
I have no such thought.
A tomb has no use for that.
There is no need to say that.
I turn my body to one side.
I keep this chamber.
That is the wrong question.
I bring my blade across.
I go on patrolling this chamber.
What lies in a tomb belongs to the dead.
I flick it up with my blade tip.
This thing had an owner once.
I set it back on the slab.
I hold it, then put it down.
Whose it is, I do not ask.
It freezes to my hand.
This serves no purpose.
I toss it into the corner.
None of these are of any use to me.
You entered the chamber.
I lift my head, and my blade.
You have been spotted.
My blade is pointed at you.
This chamber does not welcome the living.

lines.zh: 我让甲片一片片转向你。
lines.en: Plate by plate, I turn toward you.
You will not leave this passage.
My blade is already at shoulder height.
I strike first.
That warmth on you.
I count from three.
You will not leave this time.
My blade is already overhead.
Do not retreat further.

lines.zh: 这脚步我听过几百回了。
lines.en: I have heard that step a hundred times.
You are inside my reach.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的影子往前挪。
lines.en: I walk up your shadow, step by step.
My blade stays on you.
You fall back; my blade follows.
I am hunting your opening.

lines.zh: 我的甲很厚，你的刀不轻
lines.en: My plate is thick; your blade is not.
I will let you spend your strength first.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷气里成霜
lines.en: My breath turns to frost.
I have backed you to the coffin's edge.

lines.zh: 我从另一个方向绕过去
lines.en: I come around from another side.
Your guard is too high.
Frost creeps down my blade.

lines.zh: 我一边挪一边数你的脚步
lines.en: I shift and count your steps.

lines.zh: 你的架势里有一处空了。
lines.en: There is a gap in your guard.

lines.zh: 我封住了你背后那堵墙。
lines.en: I have closed the wall at your back.

lines.zh: 再近一步，你就进我剑里。
lines.en: One step closer and you are inside my reach.
This one will be cold.
I am ready on my side.
My blade comes down.
The blade carries frost.
The cold slows you.
I follow with another.
That was a solid block.
My edge grazes your shoulder.
I put my whole body into it.
You fall back; I keep on.
My plate takes your counter.
Frost closes over your wound.
I raise my blade overhead.
That one was ice.
You will not close again.
The frost arrives before my blade does.
These two arms can still swing.
This chamber is mine.
I rise from the coffin.
The chamber has another guard.
I raise my blade, and cold spills out.
I have waited here many years.
Ice still clings to my armour.
I step out of the dark.
The frost on the slabs deepens.
I lower my helmet.
Something living has come in.
I work my fingers slowly.
I take the middle of the passage.
My blade is drawn.
Fire melts the frost on me.
I roll down the steps.
Tomb water floods my armour.
The blast hurls me into the stone wall.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的甲缝里
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my plate seam.

lines.zh: 魔法烧穿了我身上的寒气
lines.en: Magic burns through the cold in me.
The dead have no need to eat.

lines.zh: 雷顺着墓道劈到我身上
lines.en: Lightning runs down the passage into me.
The flagstones are gone.
